title: Come Have Coffee with Us
writer: Piero Chiara, Alberto Lattuada, Adriano Baracco
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Milena Vukotic
plot: Emerenziano, a middle-aged tax inspector, is in search of a wealthy wife. He travels to Italy where he meets three sisters, who, though wealthy, are not by any stretch of the imagination young or beautiful. He decides to marry one...
